_doc: E471 TRAILERS T15: the four 15-second variants' sound design. MOSS-SoundEffect v2 and Stable Audio 3 Medium each, the better take by CLAP rank (sfx_pick.py). `desc` is the CLAP ranking text.

t15-typing.desc: someone typing on a quiet laptop keyboard
t15-typing.prompt: Close, quiet recording of one person typing a sentence on a laptop keyboard in a calm room at night: soft individual key taps with small natural pauses between words, one space bar thump now and then. No music, no voices.

t15-enter.desc: a single firm press of the enter key
t15-enter.prompt: A single firm press of the Enter key on a laptop keyboard, close-up, one clean click and release, then silence. No music.

t15-glyphs.desc: a soft shimmering scatter of tiny digital ticks rising
t15-glyphs.prompt: A soft, delicate scatter of thousands of tiny glassy ticks and clicks swirling upward and settling, like letters flying off a page and landing in place, gentle shimmer, ending in a quiet bright chime. Sound design, no music.

t15-pen.desc: a dip pen nib scratching ink lines on paper
t15-pen.prompt: Close-up recording of a dip pen nib drawing quick ink lines and small hatching strokes on thick paper: scratchy nib on paper, short strokes, tiny pauses, a soft brush stroke now and then. Quiet room. No music, no voices.

t15-card.desc: a postcard dropped flat onto a wooden table
t15-card.prompt: A single thick paper postcard tossed onto a wooden table: a short papery flutter, a crisp flat slap on the wood and a tiny skid. Close-up, dry room. No music.

t15-slide.desc: a card slid across a wooden table
t15-slide.prompt: A thick paper card slid by a finger across a smooth wooden table for one second, a soft papery hiss that stops gently. Close-up, dry room. No music.

t15-wind.desc: a gentle wind over open grassland with distant sea waves
t15-wind.prompt: A calm open landscape: a gentle steady wind through tall dry grass on one side and soft distant sea waves rolling onto a beach on the other, wide and quiet, no birds, no cars, no music.
